briefing: - Barracuda邮件网关RCE已入KEV且在野利用，须立即升级修复。
- Citrix边界VPN 9.5分漏洞需优先排查并尽快修复。
- Citrix与ManageEngine多漏洞集中公告，呈批量披露趋势。
- 本批未见勒索软件标记，但RCE密集，仍须防横向移动。
- 9.8分RCE与缺失认证漏洞应优先修复，收缩暴露面。

items.title: Barracuda邮件网关时区命令注入
items.title_zh: Barracuda邮件网关时区命令注入
items.summary_zh: 已认证管理员可在时区配置注入OS命令，以root权限执行并控制设备
items.action_zh: 升级至9.4.0.029及以上，限制管理访问
items.repro_note: 管理员登录后，在时区配置字段注入命令
items.impact_scope: 邮件安全网关，边界高价值资产
items.description: Improper neutralization of shell metacharacters in the timezone configuration field in certain Barracuda appliance products using common Barracuda code allows an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed.

items.title: JeecgBoot SSRF可探测内网
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用未过滤URL参数发起SSRF，探测内网或访问内部服务
items.action_zh: 升级至3.9.6之后版本，限制出站访问
items.repro_note: 需可访问SSRF功能，构造URL参数请求内网
items.impact_scope: 协同办公系统，内网横向探测
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in JeecgBoot up to 3.9.6. This affects the function RestTemplate.exchange of the file org/jeecg/modules/airag/flow/c/a.class of the component flow-run Endpoint. The manipulation leads to server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: NetScaler内存溢出拒绝服务
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可触发NetScaler ADC/Gateway内存溢出，导致服务拒绝
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: Citrix(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，临时限制管理面暴露
items.repro_note: 向NetScaler ADC/Gateway发送特制流量触发溢出
items.impact_scope: 边界ADC/VPN设备，常暴露公网
items.description: Multiple Memory overflow vulnerabilities can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior and Denial of Service in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway.

items.title: NetScaler数据包处理内存溢出
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者利用数据包处理内存溢出，导致NetScaler异常或拒绝服务
items.affected: Citrix(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，限制不必要流量
items.repro_note: 向数据包处理路径发送特制报文触发溢出
items.impact_scope: 边界ADC/VPN设备，常暴露公网
items.description: Memory overflow in Packet Processing can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway.

items.title: NetScaler SMPP流量内存溢出
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可经SMPP流量触发内存溢出，造成NetScaler异常或拒绝服务
items.affected: Citrix(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，限制SMPP暴露
items.repro_note: 向SMPP流量路径发送特制报文触发溢出
items.impact_scope: 边界ADC/VPN设备，常暴露公网
items.description: Memory overflow in SMPP traffic can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service in Citrix NetScaler

items.title: NetScaler DNS/DoH内存破坏
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者经DNS/DoH流量触发内存破坏，造成NetScaler异常或拒绝服务
items.affected: Citrix(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，限制DNS/DoH暴露
items.repro_note: 向DNS/DoH处理路径发送特制请求
items.impact_scope: 边界ADC/VPN设备，常暴露公网
items.description: Memory corruption in DNS / DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service in Citrix NetScaler

items.title: NetScaler DoH内存破坏拒绝服务
items.title_zh: NetScaler DoH内存破坏拒绝服务
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者通过DoH请求触发内存破坏，导致NetScaler异常或拒绝服务
items.affected: Citrix(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，限制DoH暴露
items.repro_note: 构造特制DoH请求触发内存破坏
items.impact_scope: 边界ADC/VPN设备，常暴露公网
items.description: Memory corruption in DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or a Denial of Service in Citrix NetScaler

items.title: NetScaler Push内存溢出拒绝服务
items.title_zh: NetScaler Push内存溢出拒绝服务
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者利用NetScaler Push内存溢出，造成设备异常或拒绝服务
items.affected: Citrix(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，限制Push通道暴露
items.repro_note: 向NetScaler Push路径发送特制数据触发溢出
items.impact_scope: 边界ADC/VPN设备，常暴露公网
items.description: Memory overflow in NetScaler Push can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service in Citrix NetScaler

items.title: XWEB EVO登录未授权命令注入
items.title_zh: XWEB EVO登录未授权命令注入
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者在登录相关Lua脚本用户名处注入shell字符，以高权限执行命令
items.action_zh: 升级至5.7.0及以上，隔离受影响EOL设备
items.repro_note: 未授权向login.lua等用户名参数注入shell元字符
items.impact_scope: Web管理设备，可能暴露内外网
items.description: XWEB EVO versions 5.2.3 through before 5.7.0 contains a pre-authentication OS command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands by injecting shell metacharacters into the username field of login.lua, cleanout.lua, or api.lua before the password check occurs. Attackers can exploit this flaw combined with the setuid-root wlua interpreter to execute commands with root privileges, achieving full system compromise.

items.title: XWEB EVO CGI参数命令注入
items.title_zh: XWEB EVO CGI参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者通过xwconsole.cgi的sh参数注入命令，以root权限完全控制设备
items.action_zh: 升级至5.6.2及以上；EOL设备尽快下线
items.repro_note: 未授权请求xwconsole.cgi，在sh参数注入命令
items.impact_scope: Web控制台设备，EOL高风险
items.description: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root by exploiting the setuid-root CGI xwconsole.cgi. Attackers can supply malicious input through the sh parameter, which is passed unsanitized to popen(), to achieve full system compromise. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

items.title: Payara JMX/RMI认证绕过RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者伪造客户端主机地址，绕过JMX/RMI限制并获取管理权限导致RCE
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，限制JMX/RMI访问
items.repro_note: 访问暴露的JMX/RMI，伪造客户端主机地址
items.impact_scope: Java应用服务器，内网管理面
items.description: A vulnerability in the GenericAdminAuthenticator component of Azul Payara Server and Azul Payara Micro allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass JMX/RMI administrative access restrictions by spoofing the client host address. Successful exploitation can grant administrative access to the MBean server and lead to remote code execution. Azul Payara Micro is affected only when its JMX connector is enabled.

items.title: Aspire Dashboard未授权删遥测
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可通过NotFound路由删除遥测数据，影响监控与诊断信息完整性。
items.action_zh: 升级到13.6.5；临时限制Dashboard访问或禁用删除接口。
items.repro_note: 未授权请求Dashboard的NotFound路由触发删除，观察遥测变化。
items.impact_scope: 开发诊断面板，常暴露内网
items.description: ## Executive summary Microsoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in Aspire. Aspire Dashboard's unauthenticated NotFound route can permit telemetry deletion in both standalone and AppHost-hosted deployments.

items.title: Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central 未授权 缺失认证
items.affected: ManageEngine(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6301 is affected by an authentication bypass vulnerability in Windows DNS and DHCP agent synchronization APIs, allowing unauthenticated user to impersonate onboarded Windows servers and perform unauthorized DNS and DHCP modifications.

items.title: XWEB EVO 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: XWEB EVO 4.3.0 through 5.8.8 contains an unauthenticated arbitrary file write vulnerability that allows remote attackers to modify the system configuration file /etc/xwebconfig.json by sending a crafted POST request to config.lua with action=set, which performs no session validation and writes the raw, unvalidated request body.

items.title: ManageEngine DDI命令注入
items.summary_zh: 具备DNS记录权限的用户在TXT记录注入PowerShell命令，可在受管Windows DNS执行命令
items.affected: ManageEngine(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至6301及以上，限制DNS记录权限
items.repro_note: 需DNS记录权限，在TXT值注入PowerShell命令
items.impact_scope: DNS/DHCP管理平台，内网核心
items.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6301 is affected by a PowerShell injection vulnerability due to insufficient validation of user-supplied TXT record values in Windows DNS operations.

items.title: ManageEngine DDI越权命令注入
items.summary_zh: 已认证低权限用户绕过授权，通过DNS后缀值注入PowerShell，在受管DHCP服务器执行命令
items.affected: ManageEngine(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至6301及以上，收敛DHCP子网权限
items.repro_note: 低权限登录，构造DNS后缀值注入PowerShell
items.impact_scope: DNS/DHCP管理平台，内网核心
items.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6301 is affected by an authorization bypass and PowerShell command injection vulnerability that allowed authenticated non-administrative users to target unauthorized Windows DHCP subnets and potentially execute arbitrary commands on managed Windows DHCP servers through crafted DNS suffix values.

items.title: pg_restore恶意归档RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造恶意归档，诱使受害者运行pg_restore，以该OS用户权限执行任意代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级PostgreSQL修复版本，勿恢复不可信归档
items.repro_note: 构造非plain归档，诱使执行pg_restore
items.impact_scope: 数据库运维工具，需处理不可信备份
items.description: Improper input validation in PostgreSQL pg_restore allows a non-plain archive provider to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running pg_restore, via a crafted archive. Note a contrast: crafted archive data may legitimately cause arbitrary SQL to execute at the restore destination, but it does not legitimately confer arbitrary code execution in the pg_restore OS process. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

items.title: PostgreSQL plperl异常RCE
items.summary_zh: 对象创建者利用plperl异常处理缺陷触发陈旧sigjmp_buf，可能导致任意代码执行
items.repro_note: 需启用plperl并创建触发异常的对象
items.impact_scope: 数据库扩展，需对象创建权限
items.description: Uncaught exceptions in PostgreSQL plperl allow an object creator to cause use of a stale sigjmp_buf, via a tied Perl object, or a Perl object whose overloaded conversion throws while plperl is handling another error. We have not ruled out arbitrary code execution on some platform. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

items.title: 未知组件未过滤参数命令注入
items.title_zh: 未知组件未过滤参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过未过滤参数注入shell命令，以root权限在底层系统执行任意命令
items.action_zh: 确认受影响产品并升级，严格过滤参数
items.impact_scope: 受影响产品未知，需排查暴露面
items.description: XWEB EVO 5.6.2 through 5.8.8 contains an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the api.lua import_preconfiguration and restore actions, where server_url and related server credential fields are concatenated unescaped into a root curl command executed via io.popen. Attackers can inject malicious shell commands through these unfiltered parameters to achieve arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the underlying system.

items.title: datamodel代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者提供恶意JSON Schema，诱导工具生成代码时执行任意代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至0.84.0及以上，勿处理不可信Schema
items.repro_note: 构造x-python-type恶意注解的JSON Schema
items.impact_scope: 代码生成开发工具，供应链风险
items.description: datamodel-code-generator before 0.84.0 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution by supplying a malicious JSON Schema with a crafted x-python-type annotation containing a string ast.Constant node in a subscript slice position, which bypasses validation in parse_python_type_annotation and _python_type_expr_from_ast.

items.title: XWEB EVO密码字段命令注入
items.title_zh: XWEB EVO密码字段命令注入
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者在登录密码字段注入shell元字符，执行任意系统命令
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至5.6.2及以上，隔离受影响设备
items.repro_note: 未授权登录请求，在密码字段注入shell元字符
items.impact_scope: Web控制台设备，需排查暴露面
items.description: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a pre-authentication OS command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands by injecting shell metacharacters into the password field. Attackers can exploit the unescaped interpolation of the password value into the hashpass invocation within login.lua, cleanout.lua, and api.lua to achieve root-level command execution via the setuid wlua interpreter.

items.title: Create Query Reports SQL注入
items.affected: ManageEngine(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine AssetExplorer versions below 7860, ServiceDesk Plus versions below 15290, ServiceDesk Plus MSP versions below 15150, and SupportCenter Plus versions below 15150 are affected by a authenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the Reports module. An authenticated user with the Create Query Reports permission could exploit specially crafted database queries to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying server.

items.title: pg_dump转储SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 对象创建者构造恶意转储，诱使受害者恢复时以该用户执行任意SQL
items.action_zh: 升级至18.7及以上，勿恢复不可信转储
items.repro_note: 需对象创建权限，构造继承列约束名注入SQL
items.impact_scope: 数据库备份恢复，需不可信转储
items.description: SQL injection in PostgreSQL pg_dump allows an object creator to execute arbitrary SQL as the user restoring the dump, via an inherited column having a child-local not-null constraint whose name requires quoting. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

items.title: 数据库MCP查询SQL注入可越权
items.title_zh: 数据库MCP查询SQL注入可越权
items.summary_zh: 可访问MCP查询接口者可通过$mcp_custom_tool$等参数注入SQL，绕过只读读写数据。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；MCP查询参数白名单并最小化数据库权限
items.repro_note: 入口为MCP查询接口，构造$mcp_custom_tool$等参数验证只读绕过。
items.impact_scope: 数据库查询服务，常在内网
items.description: An argument containing $mcp_custom_tool$ could terminate the block and inject arbitrary SQL statements, while $mcp_args$ could inject procedural code into a plpgsql block. Because the statement used the simple query protocol, injected text could include additional statements and transaction control, bypassing read_only and accessing data or modifying resources available to the connecting role.

items.title: Red Hat仓库管理路径遍历
items.title_zh: Red Hat仓库管理路径遍历
items.summary_zh: 已认证攻击者可操控仓库名中的../序列遍历目录，篡改文件并可能提权。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；临时过滤仓库名中的../等目录遍历序列。
items.repro_note: 认证后进入仓库管理，提交含../的仓库名验证文件写入或越权。
items.impact_scope: Red Hat仓库管理组件，需认证
items.description: An authenticated attacker can exploit this issue to achieve arbitrary file modification or potential privilege escalation. The vulnerability exists because repository management operations fail to sanitize directory traversal sequences (such as '../') within repository names.

items.title: 数据库查询组件SQL注入绕过只读
items.title_zh: 数据库查询组件SQL注入绕过只读
items.summary_zh: 只读连接上的query_database可提交分号多语句，绕过只读限制执行SQL。
items.action_zh: 升级到1.1.0；禁用多语句并强制参数绑定。
items.repro_note: 在只读连接调用query_database，提交分号多语句验证执行。
items.impact_scope: 数据库查询接口，内网组件
items.description: Prior to 1.1.0, query_database on a read_only connection could send unrecognized statements through pgx Exec without bind parameters, selecting PostgreSQL's simple query protocol and allowing multiple semicolon-separated statements in one request. A caller could combine transaction or session state changes with database writes, and pooled session state could leave later calls writable, when the connecting role held write privileges.

items.title: 管理路径大小写绕过认证
items.title_zh: 管理路径大小写绕过认证
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者利用大小写处理不一致绕过/admin等授权，可读受保护内容并执行Lua。
items.action_zh: 修复路径大小写规范化；临时限制/admin、/repo、/data访问。
items.repro_note: 未授权请求/admin等路径的大小写变体，验证授权绕过及Lua读取。
items.impact_scope: 管理/仓库接口，未认证可访问
items.description: Prior to version 1.17.10, Algernon's URL-prefix authorization gate matches its protected prefixes (/admin, /repo, /data) with case-sensitive strings.HasPrefix, while the exact same raw req.URL.Path is later resolved against the filesystem. The result is an unauthenticated bypass of the /admin, /repo, and /data authorization boundary, enabling read (and, for Lua files, execution) of protected content.

items.title: Payara管理REST认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者伪造X-GlassFish-authToken头绕过管理REST限制，执行命令完全控制服务器。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；临时禁用管理REST远程访问并校验authToken头。
items.repro_note: 向管理REST添加任意authToken头，未认证调用管理命令。
items.impact_scope: Payara管理REST，暴露可完全接管
items.description: A vulnerability in the administration REST interface of Azul Payara allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass secure-admin remote-access restrictions by supplying an arbitrary value in the X-GlassFish-authToken HTTP header. Successful exploitation grants execution of arbitrary administrative commands, equivalent to complete compromise of the server.

items.title: MISP外部工具管理未授权访问
items.title_zh: MISP外部工具管理未授权访问
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可经外部工具管理功能增删改工具配置，窃取API密钥并篡改采集URL。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制管理接口访问并轮换相关密钥。
items.repro_note: 未授权访问外部工具管理接口，尝试新增或修改工具配置验证越权。
items.impact_scope: MISP情报平台，管理面暴露风险
items.description: An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the website could add arbitrary external tools, delete existing tools, toggle their active status, and modify their configurations including API keys and ingestion URLs. This inconsistency allowed bypass of the intended access control for the external tools management functionality.

items.title: MISP外部工具密钥信息泄露
items.title_zh: MISP外部工具密钥信息泄露
items.summary_zh: 未认证访问外部工具管理接口可读取API密钥，冒用MISP实例访问外部服务。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制管理接口并立即轮换泄露密钥。
items.repro_note: 未授权访问外部工具管理页面或API，检查响应是否返回API密钥。
items.impact_scope: MISP情报平台，密钥泄露可横向
items.description: The MISP Modules website component contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the external tools management interface. These keys are used by the server to authenticate submissions to external analysis or enrichment services, so their disclosure allows an attacker to impersonate the MISP instance or directly access those external services.

items.title: TIBCO TIBCO Platform 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: Authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in TIBCO TIBCO Platform’s Self-Hosted Control Plane. This issue affects TIBCO Platform’s Self-Hosted Control Plane: from 1 through 1.21.

items.title: Missing 未授权 缺失授权(越权)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: Missing authorization in PostgreSQL logical replication allows a compromised publisher to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the superuser-owned subscription, via naming a system catalog as a replication target. Only subscriptions owned by a superuser are vulnerable. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

items.title: 未授权 CWE-248
items.description: In Progress® Telerik® UI for ASP.NET MVC versions `2012.2.710` through `2026.3.1015`, server-side filter processing does not properly validate descriptor types, null values, or stack state in FilterNodeVisitor and does not catch FilterParserException within the affected assembly. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this if the application exposes an endpoint reachable without authentication that accepts crafted filter parameters.

items.title: DataSourceRequest 未授权 CWE-674
items.description: In Progress® Telerik® UI for ASP.NET Core versions `2015.1.318` through `2026.3.1015`, the server-side FilterParser processes nested expressions in untrusted filter parameters through recursive parsing without a recursion-depth limit, while FilterLexer does not enforce an input-length limit. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this if the application exposes an endpoint using DataSourceRequest model binding that is reachable without authentication.

items.title: Plesk Obsidian 权限错误
items.description: The Plesk GoAccess statistics integration in Plesk Obsidian for Linux, versions 18.0.77 to 18.0.81.7, 18.0.82 to 18.0.82.2, allows cross-subscription information disclosure.

items.title: XWEB EVO 未授权 硬编码凭据
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: XWEB EVO through 5.8.8 contains a predictable credential generation vulnerability that allows attackers to derive the Linux root password by computing a fixed prefix combined with a daily password value. Attackers can calculate the deterministic root credential, which before 5.7.0 was identical across all units and from 5.7.0 onward remains derivable from the MAC-based daily password, to gain unauthorized root access to the underlying operating system.

items.title: ANON_ACCESS 未授权 CWE-665
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. The affected element is an unknown function of the file etc/init.d/service_smbd.sh of the component SMB Service. Performing a manipulation of the argument ANON_ACCESS results in improper initialization. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: XWEB EVO 未授权 硬编码凭据
items.description: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a hardcoded backdoor password vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full administrative access to the built-in Administrator account. Attackers can authenticate using the hardcoded credential xwebevonewgeneration in a single request to obtain a complete admin session and full control over the application. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

items.title: Jail CWE-183
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: A flaw was found in rubygem-safemode. Compound assignment expressions in sandboxed code are evaluated without mediating method calls through the Jail allow-list. An authenticated attacker who can supply template content can invoke arbitrary no-argument methods on objects exposed to the template renderer without Jail mediation, including destructive operations such as host deletion and disclosure of non-allow-listed object state.

items.title: Grafana ES数据源代理越权
items.summary_zh: 可查询ES数据源的已认证用户可越权调用接口，篡改索引映射或访问其他索引
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.affected: Grafana(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Grafana修复版本，最小化ES数据源权限
items.repro_note: 需ES数据源查询权限，构造代理路径访问其他索引
items.impact_scope: 监控可视化平台，内网数据面
items.description: The Elasticsearch data source resource proxy forwards the request method and path to Elasticsearch using the data source's own credentials, without restricting them to the operations the plugin needs. A user who can query the data source can alter index mappings or reach other indices on the cluster. [Improper authorization / path validation]

items.title: PostgreSQL SQL注入
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.description: SQL injection in PostgreSQL reindexdb allows an object creator to execute arbitrary SQL as the database user running reindexdb, via a crafted index name embedded in the parallel catalog query for --jobs with --index. Within major versions 17-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 and 17.12 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected.

items.title: Food Ordering后台任意文件上传
items.title_zh: Food Ordering后台任意文件上传
items.summary_zh: 访问admin/update_food.php并操控cmd参数可上传任意文件，导致远程代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级或修补update_food.php，校验上传并禁用目录执行。
items.repro_note: 请求update_food.php，经cmd参数上传PHP验证执行。
items.impact_scope: 小型订餐系统后台，可远程利用
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Food Ordering System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file admin/update_food.php of the component Admin Image Handler. Such manipulation of the argument cmd leads to unrestricted upload. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: Food Ordering多参数SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 操控title/description/price等参数可注入SQL，读取或篡改数据库。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；所有参数参数化查询并过滤输入。
items.repro_note: 向title/price等参数提交SQL载荷，观察报错或数据变化验证注入。
items.impact_scope: 小型订餐系统数据库，数据泄露
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Food Ordering System 1.0. This affects an unknown part of the file admin/add_category.php of the component Admin Write Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument title/description/price/current_image/featured/active/id results in sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: WinForms 反序列化(RCE)
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: In Telerik UI for WinForms, versions prior to 2026.4.1111, a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability exists that allows an attacker to perform unauthorized actions in the context of the affected application.

items.title: WPF 代码注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: In Telerik UI for WPF, versions prior to 2026.4.1110, an improper control of code generation vulnerability exists that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code in the context of the affected application.

items.title: WPF 反序列化(RCE)
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: In Telerik UI for WPF, versions prior to 2026.4.1110, a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability exists that allows an attacker to perform unauthorized actions in the context of the affected application.

items.title: CGI CWE-250
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a command injection vulnerability where the setuid-root Lua CGI interpreter wlua executes system("/usr/bin/lua "+argv) on unsanitized input. Attackers can craft malicious input reached through a .lua CGI endpoint to inject arbitrary commands into the concatenated argv string, achieving command execution with root privileges. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

items.title: BSON 反序列化(RCE)
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.description: A type allow-list bypass in the BSON serialization library of the MongoDB C# Driver allows a type-restriction check to be circumvented when polymorphic data is deserialized into loosely typed members. An unauthorized party who can supply or plant BSON/JSON data that the application later deserializes can cause the application process to instantiate .NET types outside the intended allow-list and populate them with unauthorized party-controlled values.

items.title: Microchip XSS
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.description: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microchip the TimePictra platform could allow an authenticated, low-privileged attacker to store malicious script content that executes when another user views the affected page

items.title: Executing 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: Executing a manipulation of the argument phone can lead to improper authentication. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: AIP-PUB ACPs-community 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in AIP-PUB ACPs-community up to 2.2.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file discovery-server/app/main.py of the component Discovery Server. The manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: A vulnerability was found in lanyulei ferry 1.0.0-beta.1/1.0.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file middleware/auth.go of the component JWT Validation. The manipulation results in improper authentication. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Zackriya-Solutions Meetily 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in Zackriya-Solutions Meetily up to 0.4.1. The manipulation leads to missing authentication.

items.title: XWEB EVO 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: XWEB EVO 5.2.3 through 5.8.8 contains an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the devices.lua template handling, which allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands by injecting unescaped template source into unzip and related shell commands. Attackers can exploit this flaw through the wlua interpreter to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the affected device. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

items.title: XWEB EVO 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: XWEB EVO 5.2.3 through 5.8.8 contains an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root by injecting shell metacharacters into the output device path parameter processed by backup.lua. Attackers can exploit the unescaped concatenation into mount, unzip, and related shell commands run via the wlua interpreter, including through the setuid xwbackup.cgi and xwrestore.cgi interfaces, to achieve full system compromise.

items.title: Incorrect CWE-276
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.description: Incorrect directory permissions within AMD Vivado™ Lab Solutions could allow a local user-privileged attacker to escalate their privileges, potentially resulting in arbitrary code execution.

items.title: PostgreSQL SQL注入
items.description: SQL injection in PostgreSQL extension-script substitutions allows an attacker with database-level CREATE privilege to execute arbitrary code as the bootstrap superuser, via a schema or owner name containing newlines or other special substrings. This is similar to CVE-2023-39417, but it requires a non-bundled extension with a vulnerable script pattern. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

items.title: 权限错误
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: The Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket (/tmp/dynamic_socket) without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

items.title: TÜBİTAK BİLGEM Yazılım Teknolojileri 缺失授权(越权)
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in TÜBİTAK BİLGEM Yazılım Teknolojileri Araştırma Enstitüsü pardus-image-writer allows Privilege Escalation. This issue affects pardus-image-writer: before 0.9.0.

items.title: Gaia Portal 权限提升
items.difficulty: 中(需相邻网络·需低权限)
items.description: An input and authorization validation vulnerability in Gaia Portal backend handlers could allow an authenticated, non-administrative user to perform privileged operations that should be restricted to administrators.
